ladakh.m: Markha Valley (5 to 8 days, about 50 miles, homestays and camping, trek, Jun-Sep); Sham Valley trek (3 to 5 days, village homestays, trek, Jun-Sep)

lake-district.d: Helvellyn by Striding Edge (loop, about 8 miles, steep, May-Oct); Scafell Pike from Wasdale Head (out and back, about 8 miles, steep, May-Oct); Catbells (loop, about 3.5 miles, steady, year-round); Derwentwater shore (loop, about 10 miles, easy, year-round)
lake-district.m: Cumbria Way (4 to 5 days, about 70 miles, B&Bs, trek, Apr-Oct)

lapland.m: Hetta-Pallas (4 to 5 days, about 31 miles, wilderness huts, trek, Jun-Sep); Karhunkierros (4 to 6 days, about 50 miles, huts and camping, trek, Jun-Sep)

lisbon.d: Sintra Moorish Castle and Pena Park paths (loop, about 4 miles, steady, Mar-Nov); Serra do Risco coastal ridge in Arrabida (out and back, about 5 miles, steady, Mar-Nov)

lofoten.d: Reinebringen (out and back, about 2 miles on stone steps, steep, Jun-Aug); Kvalvika Beach and Ryten (out and back, about 4 to 5 miles, steep, Jun-Aug)
lofoten.st: One blog (repeated in many language versions, not an official notice) says the Reinebringen trail is often closed because of rockfall, with closures in 2024 to 2026; confirm with Visit Lofoten or the Reine tourist office before planning it.

london.d: Box Hill circular from Dorking (loop, about 5 miles, steady, year-round); Thames Path sections (point to point, 5 to 10 miles, easy, year-round); Epping Forest loops (loop, 3 to 6 miles, easy, year-round)

los-cabos.d: Sierra de la Laguna long day hikes (out and back, steep, Nov-Mar); Canyon de la Zorra waterfall hike (out and back, steady, Nov-Mar)
los-cabos.m: Sierra de la Laguna crossing (2 to 3 days, camping, trek, Nov-Mar)

luangprabang.d: Pha Daeng Peak at Nong Khiaw (out and back, about 3 hours round trip, steep, Nov-Feb); Pha Noy viewpoint (out and back, about 1 hour, steep, Nov-Feb)
luangprabang.m: Village-to-village treks in northern Laos (2 to 3 days, village homestays, trek, Nov-Feb)

madagascar.d: Isalo Piscine Naturelle (out and back, about 4 to 5 miles, steady, Apr-Nov; guide required); Canyon des Rats (out and back, short, easy, Apr-Nov; guide required)
madagascar.m: Andringitra to Pic Boby (3 to 5 days, camping, trek, Apr-Nov)

madeira.d: Caldeirao Verde levada (out and back, about 8 miles, steady, Mar-Nov); Pico do Arieiro to Pico Ruivo (point to point, about 7 miles, steep, Apr-Oct); Levada das 25 Fontes (out and back, about 7 miles, steady, Mar-Nov)
madeira.st: The Pico do Arieiro to Pico Ruivo trail (PR1) reopened in April 2026 after about 20 months closed following the August 2024 wildfire; one source says it was closed Monday to Thursday for construction as of May 2026. Another source says all 42 recommended trails will need an online booking with a time slot, with fees of EUR 7 to 10.5; confirm on the regional government trail page.

maldives.d: Sandbank walks and island loops (loop, under 2 miles, easy, Dec-Apr)

mallorca.d: Torrent de Pareis gorge (point to point, about 5 miles with scrambling and a swim, steep, May-Oct); Archduke's Trail near Valldemossa (point to point, about 6 miles, steady, Mar-Nov)
mallorca.m: Dry Stone Route GR 221 (7 to 8 days, about 90 miles, mountain refuges, trek, Mar-May and Sep-Nov)

marlborough-abel-tasman.d: Abel Tasman Coast Track sections by water taxi (point to point, 5 to 10 miles, easy to steady, year-round); Queen Charlotte Track sections by water taxi (point to point, 5 to 12 miles, easy to steady, year-round)
marlborough-abel-tasman.m: Abel Tasman Coast Track (3 to 5 days, 37 miles, huts and campsites, Great Walk, year-round); Queen Charlotte Track (3 to 5 days, 44 miles, lodges and campsites, trek, year-round)

maui.d: Sliding Sands Trail into Haleakala crater (out and back, about 11 miles to Kapalaoa cabin, strenuous, year-round); Pipiwai Trail (out and back, about 4 miles, steady, year-round); Waihee Ridge (out and back, about 5 miles, steep, year-round)

mauritius.d: Le Morne Brabant (out and back, about 3 to 4 miles, steep scramble, May-Oct); Black River Gorges viewpoint trails (loop, about 2 to 7 miles, steady, May-Oct)

mendoza.d: Confluencia camp from Horcones (out and back, about 9 to 10 miles, steady, Nov-Apr); Laguna de Horcones (loop, about 1 mile, easy, Nov-Apr)
mendoza.m: Aconcagua approach to Plaza de Mulas (3 days, about 20 miles one way, camping, trek, Dec-Feb)

mexicocity.d: Desierto de los Leones forest loops (loop, about 3 to 6 miles, easy to steady, Nov-Apr); Nevado de Toluca crater lakes (out and back, short, steady, Nov-Apr)
mexicocity.m: Iztaccihuatl by the Arista del Sol (2 days, high hut or camp, strenuous trek, Nov-Mar)
mexicocity.st: Popocatepetl is closed to climbing and a 12 km exclusion zone applies around its crater; Iztaccihuatl has far fewer restrictions but parts of the Izta-Popo parks stay closed for volcanic activity, and a December 2024 wildfire closed the park for a time. Check CENAPRED's alert level and the park before planning.

milford-sound-fiordland.d: Key Summit from the Routeburn Shelter (out and back, about 4 miles, steady, Nov-Apr); Lake Marian (out and back, about 4 miles, steady, Nov-Apr)
milford-sound-fiordland.m: Milford Track (4 days, 33 miles, Great Walk huts, trek, late Oct-Apr); Routeburn Track (2 to 3 days, 20 miles, Great Walk huts, trek, late Oct-Apr); Kepler Track (3 to 4 days, 37 miles, Great Walk huts, trek, late Oct-Apr)
milford-sound-fiordland.st: Autumn and spring 2025 storms and avalanches delayed the Milford, Routeburn and Kepler seasons and closed alpine sections (DOC, Nov 2025). Bookings for 2026/27 opened 13 May (Milford), 15 May (Routeburn) and 19 May 2026 (Kepler); no 2026 closure notice was found, so check DOC before travel.

mongolia.d: Gorkhi-Terelj National Park valley and rock-formation hikes (loop, about 3 to 8 miles, easy to steady, Jun-Sep)
mongolia.m: Altai Tavan Bogd treks (5 to 10 days, camping with a guide, trek, Jun-Sep)

monterey-big-sur.d: Point Lobos State Natural Reserve loops (loop, about 2 to 5 miles, easy, year-round); Soberanes Canyon in Garrapata (loop, about 7 miles, steady, Mar-Nov); Pfeiffer Falls in Pfeiffer Big Sur State Park (out and back, about 1.5 miles, easy, year-round)
monterey-big-sur.st: Highway 1 through Big Sur reopened on 14 Jan 2026 after about three years of landslide closures, then closed again on 16 Feb 2026 after storms; an overnight full closure was scheduled for 8 Oct 2026 just north of Nepenthe (Caltrans). Park trail closures were not found; check Caltrans QuickMap and California State Parks alerts.

morocco.d: Imlil valley village walks (loop, about 4 to 8 miles, easy to steady, Mar-May and Sep-Nov)
morocco.m: Mount Toubkal (2 days, 13,671 feet, mountain refuge, strenuous trek, Mar-May and Sep-Nov)
